metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to get quick and long-lasting migraine relief.

This video will focus on reducing tension in common spots (and muscles) associated with migraines and headaches.

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, make sure to go through them all and use what works best for you.

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home and may relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and quickly get rid of your migraine!

0:00 Intro
0:59 Turtle 
3:02 The 'Migraine' Muscle
